$comment: MCP servers 公共规范（单一真源）。本文件是三套 agent（codex / claude / opencode）MCP 配置的唯一真源。修改后运行 ./generate.mjs 重新生成各 agent 配置片段。不要把明文密钥写进本文件，需要凭据的用 {env:VAR} 占位。{home} 由生成器替换为 $HOME。

codegraph.note: Local code knowledge graph for AI coding agents.

hindsight.note: Hindsight memory daemon MCP (requires local server on 127.0.0.1:8888).

hermes-tools.note: Hermes agent tool bridge. Disabled by default.

args: TOKEN=$(glab config get token --host git.standard-robots.com); export GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="$TOKEN"; export GITLAB_API_URL="http://git.standard-robots.com/api/v4"; export GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE="modify"; export GITLAB_TOOLSETS="merge_requests,branches,users"; export GITLAB_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK="true"; exec npx -y @zereight/mcp-gitlab@2.1.38
GitLab.note: GitLab MCP via @zereight/mcp-gitlab. Token from glab config.
